title: Climate Risk Country Profile: Philippines
organization: World Bank Group; Asian Development Bank
temporal_coverage: Observed climatology through 2020; projections through 2080–2099; social vulnerability evidence includes earlier cited studies.
methodology: World Bank–ADB country profile compiles climate datasets, referenced literature, observed climatology and CMIP5/KNMI projections.
limitations: National synthesis; underlying social studies are dated. Global models cannot resolve many smaller islands, and precipitation projections are uncertain.

title: DA, partners complete climate risk vulnerability assessment of BARMM provinces; recommend CRA options to guide investments, interventions
organization: Philippines Department of Agriculture, Climate Resilient Agriculture Office
geographic_coverage: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao
temporal_coverage: Six-province CRVA completed in March 2024; projected crop suitability under RCP8.5, with projection period not stated on the webpage.
methodology: DA CRAO's six-province CRVA used geospatial and secondary data validated by local offices.
limitations: Only the official summary was inspected; underlying reports, datasets and projection horizons were unavailable.

title: Understanding Climate, Conflict, and Environmental Impacts in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM): Workshop Report
organization: Harvard Humanitarian Initiative; Mindanao State University–Iligan Institute of Technology
geographic_coverage: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao
temporal_coverage: Two-day workshop held 30–31 May 2023; case accounts describe historical and then-current conditions without consistent event dates.
methodology: Two-day 2023 workshop; 70 actors invited, 29 organizations attended in person.
limitations: Qualitative workshop accounts; local residents, Indigenous groups and other vulnerable people were absent; no causal testing.

title: Philippines 2026 Joint Workplan: Summary Document
geographic_coverage: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao
temporal_coverage: Reports selected 2025 context and sets out 2026 activities under the 2024–2028 cooperation framework.
methodology: UN 2026 workplan summarizes 2025 context, planned support and programme status.
limitations: Self-reported or planned activity, not outcome evaluation or climate-conflict evidence.

title: Philippines Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Official landing-page summary includes projection to 2040; report publication date not stated on the page.
methodology: World Bank landing summary describes prior-work synthesis, partial-equilibrium sector analyses and CGE modeling.
limitations: Landing page only; full report unavailable, so model assumptions and local estimates were not inspected.
